title: Constitutional EPICON
description: Fixed-schema ledger commitment derived from an operational EPICON before execution of an EP-2 (elective) or EP-3 (mandatory) action. Contains commitments and attestations only — never raw operational evidence or PII. See specs/EPICON_TIERING_SPEC_v0.1.md.

id.description: UUIDv7 shared with the originating operational EPICON. Version nibble MUST be 7; variant nibble MUST be 8/9/a/b (RFC 9562).

tier.description: EPICON consequence tier. EP-1 actions never produce constitutional EPICONs. Note: EP-* is the EPICON tier namespace, distinct from DVA agent tiers T1/T2/T3.

policy_rule_id.description: Identifier of the policy-registry rule that classified this action. Classification is never performed by the acting agent (Rule 5.1).

operational_merkle_root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root over the canonical per-field encoding of the operational EPICON, enabling selective field disclosure with inclusion proofs (spec §9.1).

reconstruction_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 evidence-replay fingerprint per spec §7. Guarantees reconstructability, not bitwise reproducibility.

actor_commitment.description: Hash of actor identity or civic_id shard reference. MUST NOT contain raw PII.

proposer_model.description: Optional model identifier + version of the AI proposer, when the action was AI-proposed and disclosure is policy-permitted.

policy_outcome.description: Gate result. DENY and QUARANTINE outcomes are recorded in the append-only quarantine store (Rule 8.3), not as constitutional EPICONs.

attestations.description: Signatures of the authorized attestor set. For Mobius canon EP-3 operations this is the seal quorum; the set MUST be disjoint from the proposing actor (spec §9.3).

attestor.description: Attestor identifier (e.g. ATLAS, ZEUS, EVE, JADE, AUREA, or an external authorized validator id).

signature.description: Detached signature over id || tier || operational_merkle_root || reconstruction_fingerprint || timestamp.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 time of constitutional EPICON creation. MUST precede execution time.

mec_citation.description: Optional MEC-grammar citation binding this action to sealed canon (C-365 Option B). Agent codes MUST be members of AGENT_CODES in packages/mec-parser — pattern MUST match MEC_CONSTITUTIONAL_PATTERN. Example: E01.RB341.C365.S016:Q5:AT+ZE+EV+JA+AU:GI064.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous constitutional EPICON block in the append-only chain (.dat cold-canon family, magic bytes MOBIUS01).
